prior_art.title: Step-by-Step: Separating Planning from Realization in Neural Data-to-Text Generation
prior_art.implication: Symbolic content planning followed by neural surface realization is established prior art. KRC cannot claim novelty solely because P and G are split.

prior_art.title: Sentence-Level Content Planning and Style Specification for Neural Text Generation
prior_art.implication: Sentence-level plan plus style control predates KRC; distinguish whether Korean pragmatic role typing and hard fact provenance add identifiable value.

prior_art.title: Data-to-text Generation with Macro Planning
prior_art.implication: Document-level macro plans and reader improvements have evidence. Our small six-brief pilot does not outperform or supersede these findings.

prior_art.title: Text Generation from Discourse Representation Structures
prior_art.implication: Graph-level semantics, presupposition, coreference and realization already studied; KRC should test Korean-specific informational structure and discourse/genre realization constraints.

prior_art.title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Study of Position Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge
prior_art.implication: LLM critic scores are susceptible to positioning bias; use randomized blind human panels and separate mechanical factual witness roles.

prior_art.title: Correlated Errors in Large Language Models
prior_art.implication: Different language models can share correlated failure modes. Independent critic should not be called ground truth simply because it is a separate LLM.

specific_KRC_hypotheses: Korean pragmatic realizers depend on typed speaker/addressee relation, referent recoverability and topic-focus information state in ways not captured by surface blacklist edits.

The writer may exhibit content-faithful Korean asymmetry (cadence, sentence skeleton variation, unsaid recoverable material), while a surface-template ablation accounts for only a portion of any perceived improvement.
Hard semantic/source warrants plus partially ordered reader effects provide a more honest generator feedback object than a scalar 'humanlike' discriminator.
strongest_competitors: Generic checkpoint with equal facts and no KRC
Same checkpoint with only word-pattern blacklist
Same checkpoint with equally long free-text planning instruction, no typed compiler — not included in v0.1 and therefore needed for pure type-system attribution
Alternative fact-chain or rhetorical plan with same token budget — future ablation, not v0.1
defeat_conditions: If surface-only A matches K in blinded reader quality, the typed formalism has not earned additional complexity.
If K writes more unsupported facts or weakens clarity, evidence firewalls fail their intended purpose.
If K differs only because of extra prompt length or a hidden human-authored source-order advantage, do not attribute results to graph typing.
If blind readers disagree significantly or ask different genre-specific standards, do not collapse to one universal naturalness score.
If independent checks are only keyword scanners, do not claim actual semantic guarantees over generated surface text.
next_theory_test: After v0.1 fixed 18 outputs, examine mechanism confounds and design one equal-token-length plan ablation on new briefs only if results warrant it.
